payload.title: File:Amazonsaurus Skeletal.svg
payload.description_html:
Skeletal reconstruction of the basal rebbachisaurid sauropod dinosaur Amazonsaurus maranhensis. Unkown regions were restored after Lavocatisaurus, Demandasaurus, Limaysaurus, Nigersaurus, Comahuesaurus, and Zapalasaurus.

References:

  • Carvalho, Ismar de Souza.; Avilla, Leonardo dos Santos; Salgado, Leonardo (2003). "Amazonsaurus maranhensis gen. et sp. nov. (Sauropoda, Diplodocoidea) from the Lower Cretaceous (Aptian–Albian) of Brazil". Cretaceous Research 24: 697-713. Archived from the original on 2019-01-24. Retrieved on 2019-03-31.
  • Canudo, J.; Carballido, J.; Garrido, A.; Salgado, L. (2018). "A new rebbachisaurid sauropod from the Aptian–Albian, Lower Cretaceous Rayoso Formation, Neuquén, Argentina". Acta Palaeontologica Polonica 63: 679-691. DOI:10.4202/app.00524.2018.
  • Calvo, J. O.; Salgado, L. (1995). "Rebbachisaurus tessonei sp. nov. a new Sauropoda from the Albian-Cenomanian of Argentina; new evidence on the origin of the Diplodocidae". Gaia 11: 13-33.
  • Fernández-Baldor, Fidel Torcida (2012) Sistemática, filogenia y análysis paleobiogeográfico de Demandasaurus darwini (Sauropoda, Rebbachisauridae) del Barremiense Superior-Aptiense de Burgos (España) (Thesis)[1], Universidad Zaragoza
